EmulatorJS (https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS) is GPL-3.0 licensed.
The libretro cores in data/cores/ are third-party emulator cores, each under its
own license (mostly GPL/permissive). These files are vendored here UNMODIFIED to
allow offline play; their own licenses apply to them -- not the MIT license that
covers the rest of this project. No game ROMs are included or distributed.
Source: https://cdn.emulatorjs.org/
